p: [Who it was for and what they needed, in two or three sentences.]

Python Discord bot that connects tournament roster data to player verification and match acknowledgements, then keeps live match and support state on disk so those workflows can recover after restarts.
[One or two sentences on the hardest part, and how you solved it.]

A match opens with /match_start (best of 1, 3 or 5) and players log each game with /game_result. The other team has five minutes to acknowledge it. Either side can file a dispute instead, which pauses the timers and alerts the Marshals. Live matches are kept on disk, so a restart loses nothing.
